title: Problems Around Polynomials — Conjecture 7
exact_target: Are all Descartes-admissible positive and negative root counts attainable whenever both counts are positive?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2200012 (AMR-021-0012). CC BY 4.0.
